items.title: MP Materials Stock And Rare Earth Shares Backed by US Supply Chain Demand
items.summary: This article highlights three rare earth metal stocks – MP Materials, USA Rare Earth, and Lynas Rare Earths – emphasizing their roles in the critical minerals supply chain for clean energy, advanced technology, and defense. It details each company's operations, market capitalization, strategic importance, and financial outlook, including their challenges and opportunities within the context of global demand and geopolitical considerations. The piece underscores the significance of these companies in establishing secure, non-Chinese rare earth supply chains.

items.title: Timken’s New Commercial and Operations Structure Might Change The Case For Investing In TKR
items.summary: Timken (NYSE: TKR) has announced significant leadership changes, appointing a new Chief Commercial Officer and Chief Operating Officer, effective September 1st. These changes aim to unify the sales force and centralize supply chain oversight, potentially impacting the company's growth and efficiency goals. While these roles are central to Timken's strategy for improving commercial execution and leveraging pricing and efficiency to offset cost pressures, investors should also consider the potential risks from soft industrial demand.

items.title: Empowered Funds LLC Sells 68,463 Shares of General Motors Company $GM
items.summary: Empowered Funds LLC significantly reduced its stake in General Motors (NYSE:GM) during the first quarter of 2026, selling 68,463 shares and retaining 69,284 shares valued at $5.16 million. Despite strong quarterly earnings that surpassed expectations, GM faces concerns regarding substantial insider selling, potential tariff risks, and uncertainties surrounding its long-term electric vehicle strategy. The company maintained its 2026 EPS guidance, and analysts have a consensus price target of $101.41, though recent insider sales and mixed sentiment highlight ongoing challenges.

items.title: Consumer Staples Stocks To Watch As Cooling Inflation Reshapes Essential Spending
items.summary: This article identifies three consumer staples stocks—Dingdong (Cayman) (DDL), Andersons (ANDE), and Cobram Estate Olives (ASX:CBO)—that are positioned to benefit from cooling inflation, falling energy prices, and shifting consumer spending habits. It examines how these companies, spanning online groceries, agriculture, and olive oil production, cater to essential household needs while highlighting their unique market positions, financial performance, and potential risks. The piece suggests these stocks as starting points for investors seeking opportunities in a redefined essential spending landscape.

items.title: 3 Fixed-Income ETFs Show Why Yield Is Only Part of the Income Story
items.summary: This article compares three fixed-income ETFs – BBHY, BKLN, and JAAA – highlighting that while all aim for income, their strategies, risks, yields, and fee structures vary significantly. It explains how these ETFs approach high-yield corporate bonds, senior secured loans, and AAA-rated CLO tranches, respectively, and how each would perform under different market conditions, emphasizing that investors must consider more than just yield.

items.title: American Airlines flights from New York to Israel canceled through March 2027
items.summary: American Airlines has extended the cancellation of all flights to Ben-Gurion Airport from New York's JFK until at least March 2027, citing regional unrest. The airline has not operated this route since October 2023 following the Hamas-led October 7 massacre and had previously planned to resume flights in March 2026. While American Airlines' services remain suspended, competing US carriers Delta Air Lines and United Airlines are expected to resume their Israel flights before the end of 2026.

items.title: Prediction: Costco Will Become a Trillion Dollar Company on This Date
items.summary: This article predicts that Costco (COST) will become a trillion-dollar company by 2035, reaching $2,250 per share. Despite its current market cap of $422 billion and relatively slow stock growth, strong fundamentals like 45.5% earnings growth, an 89.7% worldwide membership renewal rate, and increasing executive membership penetration support this long-term outlook. The author argues that while Wall Street sees limited upside, compounding earnings growth and strategic expansions could drive the stock to this ambitious target.

items.title: Lazard Asset Management LLC Buys 13,327 Shares of FTI Consulting, Inc. $FCN
items.summary: Lazard Asset Management LLC significantly increased its stake in FTI Consulting (NYSE:FCN) by 380.6% in the first quarter, acquiring 13,327 additional shares and bringing its total holdings to 16,829 shares valued at $3.0 million. This comes as FTI Consulting reported record second-quarter revenue of $993.5 million, though adjusted EPS of $2.16 missed estimates, and the company lowered its full-year GAAP EPS guidance to $8.70–$9.30 despite reaffirming revenue guidance. Institutional investors own 99.36% of the company, while insiders have also been buying shares, and the company repurchased 2.6 million shares during the quarter.

items.title: Werner Enterprises (WERN) Reports Higher Sales And Lower Profit, Is The 12% Discount Warranted?
items.summary: Werner Enterprises (WERN) reported higher sales but sharply lower net income in Q2 2026, leading to a 12% stock pullback after earnings. Despite short-term volatility, the company's year-to-date and one-year returns remain positive, and a valuation narrative suggests it is 12% undervalued at $37.42 compared to a fair value of $42.53, citing investments in modernization and automation. However, risks like higher insurance and wage costs could impact margin recovery.
